notes: Purpur's own version list mixes experimental builds above the stable line (here, "26.1.2" and "26.2") with the real 1.x release track; unlike Vanilla (which has an explicit `type: "release"` field to filter on), Purpur has no such field, so `listVersions()` filters by a plain `hasPrefix("1.")` string check (ServerJarProviders.swift:322) before sorting descending with the same compareMCVersions used elsewhere. Every resulting ServerVersionEntry carries `buildLabel: nil` and `isStable: true` unconditionally (line 324) -- the version list response has no per-entry build number at all, so there is nothing to derive either field from. Per phase7-scope.md, anywhere the product wants to show a Purpur server's "current build", the true source is the component-version domain's local-file read, never this catalog.
